entities.how_described: 本集说通过中间件可给智能体访问沙箱;Harbor 的任务通常在沙箱中运行,环境由 Docker 文件定义。

evidence.quote: But through that, you can give it access to a sandbox.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And so you basically spin up a sandbox, give it its own environment that's defined in a Docker file, and run it there.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: You define these tasks, which are bundled up things that can be run in a sandbox, and then you run a bunch of them against agents.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 微调 (fine tuning)
entities.how_described: 本集提到微调是数据飞轮里更新模型的方式之一;他们还微调了便宜的小模型(SLM)当在线评估器,避免每条 trace 都跑 Opus 那样的贵模型。

evidence.quote: You can update the model by doing fine tuning on that.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: But I think Trajectory is talking next on some fine-tuning that can be done.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01
